title: Vidu Releases Q4 Preview of Next-Generation Flagship AI Video Model
key_facts: ShengShu Technology launched Vidu Q4 Preview on 7 Oct 2026, its first public preview of a next-generation flagship model for audio and video.
Launch pricing starts at $0.014 per second, through Vidu's web product and API.
The model takes up to 15 image references and up to three audio references, with output at 2K or 4K.
The company says that with comparable output and billing, the preview gives up to five times the output for the same budget.
Final pricing, supported resolutions, features and usage terms may vary by plan and region.
The company says user feedback will shape the final release.
quote_evidence: Launch pricing starts at $0.014 per second, and the preview is available through Vidu’s web product and API platform.
ShengShu Technology said that when output specifications and billing conditions are comparable, Q4 Preview delivers up to five times the output for the same budget.

The announcement notes that final pricing, supported resolutions, feature availability and usage terms may vary by plan and region, with full pricing details and promotional terms published on Vidu’s website.
why_it_matters_hint: Independent creators and small studios get a new video tool, with claims the company has not independently tested.
